resources.string: A fight against a friend, each on their own phone.
Put the rooms server\'s address under Server, below.
%1$s is here: the game is starting…

One player creates a room and tells the other the code; the other joins with it. The game then starts on both phones: whoever created the room is player 1 and moves the menus, the other is player 2. Pick the two-player fight (Free Battle, 1P vs 2P) and fight.\n\nBoth phones need the same version of Hidden Leaf and the same mods switched on. The match uses a memory card of its own (your saves are not touched) and every character is open. The touch helpers (one-tap special, tap value) are off: both phones play by the game\'s own rules. Opening the game menu does not pause the match.
Each frame is 40 ms. Automatic picks it from the measured distance between the phones. The room creator\'s choice holds for both.
When the phones cannot reach each other directly (some mobile networks and routers), the match goes through the server. A little slower, but it plays.
The address of the Hidden Leaf Online Worker (https://…workers.dev). Both players need the same one.
Your Hidden Leaf is a different version from the server\'s. Update the app.
The room\'s game is not the same as yours: both need the same app version and the same mods switched on.
There is no room with this code (or it closed).
The room already has two players.
Server busy: try again in a moment.
Check the server\'s address (it starts with https://).
The server did not answer. Check the internet and the server\'s address.
%1$s\'s game did not start. Quit and create a new room.
The two games went apart: the match ended.
Waiting for another player on the same network…
Looking for matches on this network…
None yet. On the other phone, tap Create match.
Different app version or mods: you cannot play together.
Both phones on the same Wi-Fi (or one on the other\'s hotspot), with the same Hidden Leaf version and the same mods switched on. No internet or server needed.

One phone taps Create match; the other taps Find matches and picks it from the list. The game then starts on both phones: whoever created the match is player 1 and moves the menus, the other is player 2. Pick the two-player fight (Free Battle, 1P vs 2P) and fight. The match goes straight between the two phones over the Wi-Fi, without the internet.

Both phones need the same version of Hidden Leaf and the same mods switched on. The match uses a memory card of its own (your saves are not touched) and every character is open. The touch helpers (one-tap special, tap value) are off: both phones play by the game's own rules. Opening the game menu does not pause the match.

If the phones do not see each other: check that both are on the same network (not a guest network) and try one phone's hotspot. Some routers keep devices on the Wi-Fi apart ("AP isolation" or "client isolation").
This phone is not on a network. Connect it to the Wi-Fi (or the other phone\'s hotspot).
Could not listen on the network. Close other games that look for matches and try again.
The network stopped answering. Check the Wi-Fi and try again.
The other phone did not answer. Check that both are on the same Wi-Fi; some routers keep devices apart (guest network, AP isolation).
The other phone refused the match.
Nobody joined in 10 minutes: the match was closed.
